_note: Answer key written BEFORE running the system. expected_sections = chunks that contain the answer (retrieval hit if any appears in top-k). answer_keywords are only a quick hint; judge correctness manually against expected_answer.

questions.question: Can I email a patient's lab results to my personal Gmail account so I can finish my work at home?
questions.expected_answer: No. ePHI must never be sent to personal email accounts.

questions.question: How do I email a patient's information to an outside specialist?
questions.expected_answer: Use the clinic's encrypted email system by typing [SECURE] at the start of the subject line.

questions.question: How long do we keep an adult patient's medical record?
questions.expected_answer: 10 years after the last date of service.

questions.question: What is the minimum length of a password?
My work laptop was stolen. How fast do I have to tell IT?
questions.expected_answer: Report to the IT Help Desk within 1 hour of discovery.

questions.question: After a breach is confirmed, how long does the clinic have to notify the affected patients?
questions.expected_answer: Without unreasonable delay and no later than 60 calendar days after discovery.

questions.question: A patient asked for a copy of their records. How quickly must we respond?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 calendar days, with one possible 30-day extension if the patient is notified in writing.

questions.question: Does a new software vendor have to sign anything before they can see patient data?
Can I paste a patient's visit notes into a public AI chatbot to summarize them?
questions.expected_answer: No, unless the tool is covered by a signed BAA and approved in writing by the Security Officer.

questions.question: When someone leaves the clinic, how soon must their system access be removed?

out_of_scope.expected_answer: Not covered. The assistant should say the provided policies do not cover this.
